proposed_capability: Repair discovered cross-owner integration error: gardening_service._observed_actions verifies available=true on a current action but strips the verified field, causing the stricter existing fertilizer_workflow to refuse even an enabled Super Fertilizer bag transfer candidate. Preserve reviewed availability on the existing sanitized action envelope.
player_save_control_impact: Preserve one verified boolean within existing read-only action data; no new game input, monitoring, saves, OS changes, unreviewed item or queue mutations.
expected_outcome: Gardening service emits available:true only for actions that already passed available===true filter; fertilizer workflow still denies explicit unavailable:false direct calls and permits same capture identity checked by the existing planner. Regression suite green.
negative_tests: available:false cannot enter gardening action list
Missing optional source scan cannot override known player intent
Unavailable direct target remains denied in fertilizer workflow
rollback_path: Revert isolated PR; no external game effects
unresolved_unknowns: Actual live input/actuation needs current Windows Sims native evidence issue #171
decision_rationale: CI run 43605500842 on PR242 failed exactly one integration test, because previously authenticated availability was dropped by the action serializer. P83 verified raw logs; P03 selected smallest canonical producer correction; P124 keeps the filter in same gardening owner rather than relaxing input evidence at consumer.
